implementation.summary: Added an accessible first-use control that creates the recursive dock tree from the user’s current dock order, widths, and panel mode/side. It opens every live dock leaf on desktop, keeps the canvas separate and at least 400px in the 1025px first-use fixture, supports undo/redo, and has a one-click classic-layout restoration. Invalid dock orders fail closed.
safety_properties: Moves existing live Editor DOM nodes; it does not clone them.
Undo/Redo and local workspace preferences are used; no Page Model mutation.
Save and Publish remain separate actions.
No new dependency; no production data mutation.
